raw_hints: Build rectangular base 16 blocks wide, 12 blocks deep
Construct four floors with sandstone/tan blocks as primary wall material
Add regular 2x2 window openings in grid pattern on each floor (approximately 10-12 windows per floor)
Create horizontal stonebrick bands between floors for visual separation
Build gable roof using brick blocks in stepped pattern, rising to peak at center
Construct two tall towers (approximately 2x2 base, 10+ blocks tall) at front corners
Add decorative overhanging caps to tower tops using wood/dark blocks
Place white stone block foundation around entire perimeter
Add roof overhang with wood blocks at gable edges
rebuild_intent.summary: A multi-story institutional or administrative building with a distinctive gable roof. The structure features four visible floors with regular window patterns, cream/tan colored walls with dark stonebrick accents, and two tall decorative towers flanking the main roof. A foundation of white stone blocks runs around the perimeter. The building demonstrates symmetrical design with a central gable roof and corner towers.
